name: CWD30: Crop and Weed Image Classification Benchmark
description: CWD30 is an extensive agricultural benchmark dataset curated by Zhejiang University for fine-grained crop and weed identification in precision farming. It contains over 30,000 high-resolution field images encompassing 30 different agricultural crop and weed species (including staple crops like rice, wheat, and maize alongside dominant invasive weeds such as barnyard grass and sedges). Images capture plants across varied seedling, vegetative, and flowering growth stages under diverse natural field illumination, providing an evaluation suite for automated robotic herbicide application, weeding, and smart agricultural scouting.
